final: WITH race_avgs AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.points) as avg_points FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), first_overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as first_avg FROM race_avgs), kept_races AS (SELECT ra.name, ra.avg_points FROM race_avgs ra, first_overall_avg oa WHERE ra.avg_points > oa.first_avg), final_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as final_overall_avg FROM kept_races) SELECT kr.name, kr.avg_points, kr.avg_points - oa.first_avg, kr.avg_points - fa.final_overall_avg FROM kept_races kr CROSS JOIN first_overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN final_avg fa ORDER BY kr.name
